title: Program Manager
summary: Are you looking for a career in an inspiring, global environment where your expertise makes a difference? At Neste, you will be working for the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel.
criteria: Extensive experience in R&D and engineering within process industries. | A proven track record of successfully leading projects or large workstreams in complex technology development programs. | Demonstrated ability to manage external development partners, technology licensors, research institutes, and key vendors. | Ability to understand the strategic big picture and interdependencies across workstreams and activities, paired with a highly structured day-to-day execution… | Strong interpersonal skills to partner effectively with technical leaders and align cross-functional teams without direct authority. | Fluency in English (written and spoken); strong communication skills for presenting complex topics to cross-functional teams and management.
